source.question: Explain how a hash table handles collisions and why resizing matters.
source.answer: A hash table maps each key to a position in an array. A hash function produces an integer, and the table uses part of that integer to choose a bucket. Different keys can choose the same bucket; this is a collision, not evidence that the keys are equal. The table must compare the actual keys before returning a value. With separate chaining, a bucket holds several entries, often in a linked list or a small array. With open addressing, the table searches other positions according to a probing rule. Deletion needs care in open addressing because an empty slot may otherwise stop a search too early. A tombstone can preserve the search path until the table is rebuilt. As the array fills, collisions and probing distances tend to increase. Resizing allocates a larger array and places existing entries using the new capacity. The load factor helps decide when that extra work is worthwhile. Average lookup can remain close to constant time, but a poor hash function or an adversarial set of keys can still make a particular table slow.

source.question: 데이터베이스 트랜잭션과 원자성을 예를 들어 설명해 주세요.
source.answer: 트랜잭션은 여러 작업을 하나의 논리적인 단위로 묶는 방법입니다. 예를 들어 계좌 A에서 계좌 B로 만 원을 보내려면 A의 잔액을 줄이고 B의 잔액을 늘려야 합니다. 첫 번째 변경만 저장된 상태에서 장애가 나면 돈이 사라진 것처럼 보입니다. 원자성은 이런 중간 결과가 최종 상태로 남지 않도록 보장합니다. 두 변경을 모두 완료해 커밋하거나, 실패한 변경을 취소해 이전 상태로 돌아갑니다. 격리성은 동시에 실행되는 다른 트랜잭션이 어떤 상태를 볼 수 있는지 정합니다. 격리 수준에 따라 허용되는 현상이 다르므로 원자성과 같은 뜻으로 사용하면 안 됩니다. 지속성은 커밋이 성공했다고 응답한 변경을 장애 이후에도 보존하는 성질입니다. 실제 구현에서는 로그 기록, 복구 절차, 잠금 또는 버전 관리가 함께 사용됩니다. 애플리케이션은 실패한 트랜잭션을 다시 시도할 수 있지만 외부 결제나 이메일 전송까지 자동으로 되돌릴 수 있다고 가정해서는 안 됩니다.

source.question: 请解释广度优先搜索为什么能找到无权图中的最短路径。
source.answer: 广度优先搜索从起点开始，按照经过边的数量逐层访问顶点。起点的距离是零，直接相邻的顶点距离是一，再下一层的距离是二。算法使用队列保存等待展开的顶点。发现一个尚未访问的邻居时，立即标记它，把它的距离设为当前顶点的距离加一，并记录它的前驱。因为队列先进先出，距离较小的顶点总是在距离较大的顶点之前展开，所以第一次发现某个顶点时，不会遗漏一条边数更少的路径。沿着前驱记录向起点回溯，就能恢复一条最短路径。如果图中有多个同样短的路径，具体得到哪一条取决于邻居的遍历顺序。这个结论要求每条边的代价相同。对于任意非负权重，通常应使用适合权重的最短路径算法。若在出队时才标记访问状态，同一个顶点可能被重复入队，增加不必要的工作。使用邻接表时，广度优先搜索的时间复杂度是顶点数与边数之和。

source.question: 二分探索の不変条件と境界の扱いを説明してください。
source.answer: 二分探索では、答えが存在する可能性のある区間を毎回半分程度に縮めます。まず配列が探索条件に従って整列している必要があります。半開区間を使う場合は、左端を含み右端を含まない区間を一貫して扱います。例えば最初に条件を満たす位置を探すなら、左側の確定済み部分は条件を満たさず、右側の確定済み部分は条件を満たすという不変条件を保ちます。中央の要素が条件を満たせば右端を中央に移し、満たさなければ左端を中央の次に移します。空の区間になったときの左端が求める境界です。要素が一つも条件を満たさない場合には、配列の長さが結果になります。重複した値があるとき、任意の一致を返す探索と最初の一致を返す探索は同じではありません。空の配列、一つだけの配列、全て同じ値の配列で確認すると、境界の誤りを見つけやすくなります。

source.question: Write a Python function that merges sorted integer iterables lazily, then explain its edge cases.
Show a Rust function that parses a comma-separated list of u32 values without silently dropping errors.
Derive the mean and variance of the sum of independent Bernoulli random variables.
source.answer: Let X_i be a Bernoulli random variable with success probability p_i, so X_i is either zero or one. Its expectation is p_i. Since squaring zero or one leaves the value unchanged, E[X_i squared] is also p_i. Therefore Var(X_i) = p_i minus p_i squared = p_i(1 - p_i). Define S as the sum of X_1 through X_n. Linearity of expectation gives E[S] = the sum of p_i. This expectation calculation does not require independence. For the variance, expand the square of S minus its expectation. The result is the sum of the individual variances plus twice the sum of the pairwise covariances. Independence makes every covariance between distinct variables zero. Thus Var(S) is the sum of p_i(1 - p_i). When every success probability equals p, these formulas simplify to np and np(1 - p), and S has a binomial distribution. Without independence, the expectation formula remains valid but the covariance terms must be retained. For example, if all variables equal the same Bernoulli variable, the variance is n squared times p(1 - p), not n times that quantity.

source.question: Describe a reproducible process for comparing two implementations of a numerical kernel.
source.answer: First define the workload: input shapes, data types, layouts, and the operations whose time will be measured. Preserve the same input values for both implementations. Separate initialization and data transfer from the timed region when the question concerns resident execution, and report those costs separately if they matter to the application. Warm caches can hide memory traffic, so choose a cache regime that matches actual use and state it explicitly. Use a clock and synchronization mechanism that measures completed work. Repeat both variants in alternating order to reduce the effect of gradual changes in temperature or background activity. Retain every valid sample rather than selecting only the fastest run. Compare absolute times and their ranges as well as the ratio. Check correctness against an appropriate reference. A floating point reduction can change its result when the accumulation order changes, so an exact comparison alone is not a complete numerical contract. Finally, measure the full application path. A large improvement in a rare kernel may have little visible effect, while removing a repeated conversion can save time throughout the workload.
